parity_summary.mobile: Android/iOS cfg path never starts or receives the desktop backend/data directory; it is an authenticated remote operator-node client and private database replication remains false.
parity_summary.redaction: Tokens are only used in the manager-to-child and renderer connection contract; public lifecycle status, serialized status tests, errors, logs, and this evidence contain no credentials or private communication data.
